title: Netboot with EFI iPXE
body: I'm trying to boot arch using the provided ipxe file https://archlinux.org/releng/netboot/ I formated my usb drive and copied the file : sudo mkfs.fat -F 32 /dev/sda1 udisksctl mount --block-device /dev/sda1 mkdir -p /run/media/nicolas/A857-4067/EFI/BOOT cp ipxe-arch.efi /run/media/nicolas/A857-4067/EFI/BOOT/BOOTx64.EFI umount /run/media/nicolas/A857-4067 The UEFI boot successfully into the USB drive. I chose a mirror and selected 'boot to arch'. The program downloaded the vmlinuz-linux and the sig file. Then the error message : Could not verify: Permission denied ( http://ipxe.org/0216eb8f ) The wiki refers to x509 certificate, but the mirror server only serves HTTP. I think it is misleading.
